info.title: JioAgent Local Control API
info.description: Localhost-only HTTP/JSON API for controlling JioAgent runtime state, chat turns, brief planning, skills, MCP servers, payload inspection, memory, and ApiProxy lifecycle from a web UI.

servers.description: Default control URL. Runtime replaces this with the actual bound control server URL.

get.description: Returns an allowlisted bundled browser asset or license file used by control.html.

200.description: Static browser asset or license text

post.description: Facade for supported slash commands. Does not run normal chat turns; use POST /message for assistant turns.

get.description: Token counts are rough estimates, not tokenizer-accurate.
Returns provider-reported token usage for the most recent completed Chat Completions API call when usage was present. This is not the rough /context estimate.

post.description: Existing non-streaming long-running call. It remains available for automation and returns the complete activityTimeline after the turn finishes. Clients should use a long timeout, disable duplicate send controls while pending, and call POST /cancel to request cooperative cancellation.

Starts a chat turn in the background and immediately returns a success envelope with { turnId, status: "running" }. Use GET /turns/{turnId}/events to stream display-safe turn events. If another turn is already running, returns kind=turn_already_running.

200.description: Turn status and buffered display-safe events

get.description: Non-envelope SSE endpoint. After POST /turns returns a turnId, clients connect here to receive display-safe turn events. The response content type is text/event-stream. Events replay buffered payloads for late subscribers and then stream live updates until turn_completed, turn_failed, or turn_canceled. Browser/SSE disconnect does not cancel the turn. Raw tool arguments JSON, raw tool result JSON, and raw envelope details are not included.

200.description: Server-sent event stream. Each event name matches payload.type and data is a TurnActivityEvent JSON object.

schema.description: SSE frames in the form event: {type} and data: {TurnActivityEvent JSON}. The JSON contains sequence, turnId, type, status, toolName, toolCallId, content, emoji, summary, error, turn, and timestamp.

post.description: Requests cooperative cancellation for the matching active turn. Browser/SSE disconnect does not cancel a turn; only this endpoint or the legacy POST /cancel path requests cancellation.
Read-only planning endpoint. It may return clarifying questions or a rewrittenPrompt. It does not toggle persistent console /brief mode.

put.summary: Update ApiProxy runtime config through admin API
put.description: Existing/shared proxies are blocked by default. Set forceSharedProxy=true only when the caller accepts that other AgentConsole sessions may be affected.

post.description: Only stops an ApiProxy process started by this AgentConsole. Existing/shared proxies are blocked by default.
Only restarts an ApiProxy process started by this AgentConsole. Existing/shared proxies are blocked by default.
Mutates conversation memory and may call the configured summary model.

get.summary: List tools for active MCP server
get.description: Server must be active; listing may start an external MCP process.

get.summary: List model-visible built-in and MCP tools

get.description: Returns the live agent profile for this localhost-only control server: name, role, active skills, active MCP servers, available catalogs, and conversation-safety warning.

put.description: Updates the live runtime profile for future payload builds. Unknown skills return kind=unknown_skill, unknown MCP server ids return kind=unknown_mcp_server, and MCP activation/listing failures return kind=mcp_activation_failed; these failures leave profile state unchanged. resetConversation=true resets in-memory conversation state after a successful profile update.

get.description: Returns current assistant turn runtime state for UI display and automation polling.

required.description: True when memory compaction is required.

triggerTokenCount.description: Token count used to evaluate the compaction trigger. May include latest actual usage plus a rough delta.

TeamTurnMetadata.description: Optional TeamRuntime caller metadata accepted for diagnostics/routing by higher layers. AgentConsole does not interpret or persist it into model conversation messages.

activityTimeline.description: Post-turn activity timeline for ChatGPT-style web UI rendering. Assistant pre-tool events expose display-safe content. Tool events expose display-safe toolName, toolCallId, emoji, summary, status, and optional error, not raw arguments.

toolCallId.description: Model-provided tool call id for tool_call_* events. Matches the role=tool payload message tool_call_id used by /payload/json.

content.description: Assistant text for assistant_message_before_tool_calls and assistant_final events. Raw tool arguments are never placed here.

sessionId.description: Currently accepted but not used as persistent server-side state.

forceQuestions.description: Optional one-shot hint for browser Prompt Assistant flows. When true on the first call, the planner should return clarifying questions before a rewrittenPrompt.

forceSharedProxy.description: Allow runtime config updates against an existing/shared ApiProxy after accepting the shared-session risk.

name.description: Live agent display name used in future payload system prompts.

role.description: Optional live agent role instruction used in future payload system prompts.

activeSkillNames.description: Skills active for future payload builds.

activeMcpServerIds.description: MCP servers active for future tool listing and payload builds.

availableSkillNames.description: Skill names visible as available to future payload builds.

availableMcpServerIds.description: Discovered MCP server ids that may be supplied to PUT /agent/profile.

conversationStarted.description: True when conversation memory already contains messages.

resetConversation.description: For PUT responses, true only when resetConversation=true was requested and the profile update succeeded.

profileChangeWarning.description: Present when existing conversation messages may still reflect the previous profile unless resetConversation=true is used.

name.description: New live agent display name. Null or omitted keeps the current name.

role.description: New live agent role. Null or omitted keeps the current role.

activeSkillNames.description: Full replacement set of active skill names. Unknown, unavailable, or empty names return an error and leave profile state unchanged.

activeMcpServerIds.description: Full replacement set of active MCP server ids. Unknown or failed server ids return an error and leave profile state unchanged.

resetConversation.description: When true, resets in-memory conversation state after a successful profile update so future turns do not carry previous-profile conversation messages.

runtimeState.description: Current agent runtime state. busy means an assistant turn is running.

turnRunning.description: True when AgentHost currently has an active assistant turn.
